add.k: A police detective secretly in Harrow's cult
st: DC Fitzgerald searches Steven's flat, finds a passport for Marc Spector, and drives Steven to Arthur Harrow, not to a station.
Billy follows Harrow to Egypt to dig for Ammit's tomb, and inside it a Heka Priest kills him.

files.notes: Transcript s01e02: 'DC Fitzgerald and DC Kennedy here' and Kennedy calls him 'Billy'. Kept in the Disciples of Ammit rather than the police: the screen only calls him 'DC', and he is serving Harrow when we meet him. His partner Bobbi Kennedy is not in the app, so no tie. A Duat recreation of him (a hospital orderly) appears in s01e04 and s01e05; left out of the steps as a separate figure.

add.k: Steven's bossy manager at the gallery gift shop
st: Donna scolds Steven for playing tour guide, mocks his steak date, and threatens to shove him in a sarcophagus.

files.notes: Named on screen as 'Donna' only (s01e01: 'Sorry, Donna', 'Thanks, Donna'); the surname Kraft is wiki conjecture, so n is Donna. A Duat recreation of her (a hospital patient at bingo, called Donna) appears in s01e04; left out of the steps.

add.k: A security guard at the National Art Gallery
st: J.B. calls Steven Scotty and shrugs off his plea to keep strangers out of the free museum, then walks off to take a call.
J.B. lets Steven review the footage of the wrecked toilets, but it only shows Steven, and he scoffs at the jackal story.

files.notes: Named on screen (s01e01: 'Good night, J.B.', 'Hey, J.B., how you doin', mate?'). The reviewer's note that he reports a theft and makes Steven resign is not in the s01e02 transcript: a museum manager sacks Steven after the footage, so that is left out.

add.k: Leader of the Ennead, who speaks through an avatar
st: Speaking through his avatar, Osiris hears Khonshu's charge, clears Harrow, and has Khonshu sealed in stone for turning the sky.
Osiris opens his gates to free Marc and Steven, and after Harrow storms the chamber, tells Layla to bind Ammit in a human body.

files.notes: Named on screen (s01e03: 'In attendance, Horus, Isis, Tefnut, Osiris and Hathor'; s01e06: 'The Gates of Osiris', 'Osiris, you old softie!'). He acts only through his avatar, whose name (Selim) is never said, so the avatar is not named. Raft file because he rules for Harrow and imprisons Khonshu; he ends up helping, so the last status is Allied. A reviewer may prefer a hero file.

st: Wendy blames young Marc for Randall's drowning and beats him in a drunken rage, and dies years after he leaves home.

files.notes: Named on screen by her husband in s01e05 ('Wendy? Wendy, come on, please'). Steven's phone calls to his 'Mom' in s01e01 and s01e02 are mentions only; she is first seen in s01e05. No group: Independent.

add.k: The avatar of Hathor, goddess of music and love
st: Yatzil meets Marc at the gods' council, speaks for Hathor, and tells him that Senfu's sarcophagus will lead him to Ammit's tomb.
Yatzil stands with the other avatars as Harrow storms the gods' chamber, and Harrow kills her.

files.notes: Named on screen (s01e03: 'I'm Yatzil, Avatar of Hathor'). Placed in The Ennead as Hathor's avatar on its council ('a meeting of the Ennead'); a reviewer may prefer Independent.

add.k: A mace-wielding Clandestine exiled to Earth
st: In 1942, Aadam is with the Clandestines in India when British soldiers break up their hunt for the bangle.
Aadam welcomes Kamala into his house, then swings his mace at her during Aamir's wedding until Damage Control takes him.
Aadam breaks out, chases Kamala through Karachi in a stolen truck, and is stabbed dead by Kareem.

files.notes: Named on screen (s01e03: 'Check on Aadam'; Kareem is named in s01e04 before the fight). Kept at large in 1942 since the Clandestines are a threat in Kamala's story; the 1942 scene is shown in s01e03.

add.k: A Damage Control agent under Sadie Deever
st: Barrie fires on Kamran and Kamala at Coles Academic, is blocked by the crowd, then hands Deever the call that ends the hunt.

files.notes: Named on screen by Deever in s01e06 ('Kids, Agent Barrie'). Only on screen in s01e06.

add.k: A spear-wielding Clandestine exiled to Earth
st: In 1942, Fariha is with the Clandestines when they find the bangle, and flees as British soldiers close in.
Fariha fights Kamala with her spear at Aamir's wedding, until Damage Control arrests the Clandestines.
Fariha escapes Damage Control and hunts Kamala and the Red Daggers across Karachi.
When the veil to the Noor dimension opens, Fariha runs toward home and is turned to bone.

files.notes: Named on screen (s01e03: 'Fariha, Saleem, I found the bangle'; 'Fariha! Saleem! Over here!').

add.k: The guidance counselor at Coles Academic
st: Mr. Wilson calls Kamala to his office over the intercom and presses her to plan for college instead of daydreaming.
Mr. Wilson tells Bruno he has won a free place in Caltech's Early Immersion program.
Mr. Wilson posts a video about the fight at his school, saying he is still shaking.

files.notes: Named on screen (s01e01: 'PS, this is Mr. Wilson' and 'My name is Gabe'). His s01e06 video is credited to him by the wiki; the transcript has the line but no speaker.

st: Hameed climbs the minaret for selfies and slips, and Kamala's light platforms slow his fall onto a car, hurting his ankle.
Hameed posts a video praising Ms. Marvel, wondering where those skills were when he fell.

files.notes: Named on screen in s01e02 ('Hameed!', 'Don't worry, Hameed'). The wiki says he stole Nakia's shoes in s01e02; that is not clear from the transcript, so it is left out. No group: Independent.

add.k: Owner of the Gyro King food truck
st: Najaf grumbles to Kamala and Muneeba about rich men in suits buying up the neighborhood.
At the Eid party, Najaf trades Nakia his vote for the mosque's catering, then watches Kamala save Hameed.
Najaf joins the crowd shielding Ms. Marvel from Damage Control, then boasts online that she loves his gyros.

files.notes: Named on screen (s01e01: 'What's up, Najaf?'). tm is his own food-truck business, named on screen ('The Gyro King. Not like some wannabe.'); a reviewer may prefer Independent.

st: Owais greets Kamala in Karachi and tours the city with her and Zainab, then leaves her to visit the train station alone.
When Kamala does not come home, Owais shows Muneeba how to track her phone.

files.notes: Named on screen (s01e04: 'Zainab and Owais, you are taller than I remember'). No group: Independent.

add.k: Yusuf's best friend at the mosque
st: Rasheed runs against Nakia for the mosque board and is stung to see Yusuf holding her flyer.
Rasheed helps Sheikh Abdullah stall Damage Control with his cookies, then sends Yusuf a video of the fight at the school.

files.notes: Named on screen (s01e02: 'Uncle Rasheed is running', 'Rasheed is also running. And he's my best friend'). No group shown (he is only a candidate for the board): Independent.

add.k: A gossiping auntie and friend of Muneeba
st: Muneeba's friend gossips about Fatima's broken engagement, and later tells Kamala she heard Aisha killed a man.
Ruby dances at Aamir's wedding and quizzes Sheikh Abdullah about the agents who came to the mosque.
Ruby stands in front of Agent Barrie to shield Ms. Marvel, then tells her followers she would never reveal who she is.

files.notes: First named in s01e03 by Muneeba ('I found Auntie Ruby and Humaira'), then by herself in s01e06 ('Ruby here with today's news'), so n is staged at #3 and the first step leaves the name out. The wiki gives her shop as Saeed Fashions, but I could not confirm that name on screen, so tm is Independent.

add.k: A whip-wielding Clandestine exiled to Earth
st: In 1942, Saleem is with the Clandestines when they find the bangle, and flees as British soldiers close in.
Saleem lashes at Kamala with his whip at Aamir's wedding, until Damage Control arrests the Clandestines.
Saleem breaks out, sadly leaves Kamran behind on Najma's order, and dies to Waleed's daggers in Karachi.

files.notes: Named on screen (s01e03: 'Fariha, Saleem, I found the bangle').

st: Zainab welcomes Kamala to Karachi and shows her the city, then is there when Muneeba finds Kamala missing.

files.notes: Named on screen (s01e04: 'Zainab and Owais'). No group: Independent.

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Posing as police, Billy and his partner search Steven's flat and find a passport for Marc Spector with Steven's face. They cuff him and drive him to Arthur Harrow instead of a station.
stages.whoA: The man he hands over to Harrow
stages.whoB: A crooked detective in Harrow's cult

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Billy brings Steven to Harrow, then follows him to Egypt as the cult digs for Ammit's tomb. He goes into the tomb for Harrow, and a Heka Priest kills him there.
stages.whoA: The cult leader he serves
stages.whoB: One of his followers, a detective

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Donna manages Steven at the gallery gift shop and scolds him for playing tour guide. She mocks his steak date and threatens to shove him in a sarcophagus when he asks about the Ennead.
stages.whoA: Steven, her clumsy gift shop clerk
stages.whoB: His bossy manager at the gallery

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: J.B. guards the gallery where Steven works and keeps calling him Scotty. He shrugs off Steven's fear of being followed, then lets him watch the footage of the wrecked toilets, which only shows Steven.
stages.whoA: Steven, a gallery coworker he calls Scotty
stages.whoB: The gallery guard who calls him Scotty

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Osiris warns Khonshu to stop drawing attention to the gods and dismisses his charge against Harrow. When Khonshu turns back the sky, the gods seal him in stone.
stages.whoA: The god he locks away for meddling
stages.whoB: The Ennead's leader, who imprisons him

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Osiris questions Harrow at the gods' council and rules that he has done nothing wrong. Later Harrow storms the chamber with his followers and cuts down the gods' avatars.
stages.whoA: The man he cleared, who turns on the gods
stages.whoB: The god who cleared him at the council

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: After Harrow's attack, Osiris asks Layla if she freed Khonshu. He tells her the chamber can bind Ammit in a human body, but they need more avatars.
stages.whoA: The woman he tells how to stop Ammit
stages.whoB: The god who tells her how to bind Ammit

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Yatzil sits on the council Osiris leads, speaking for Hathor at Harrow's hearing. They stand together when Harrow storms the chamber, and Harrow kills her.
stages.whoA: Hathor's avatar on his council
stages.whoB: The god who leads the council

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Wendy blames her son Marc for Randall's drowning and beats him on his birthday. Marc leaves home, and when she dies he refuses to go to her shiva.
stages.whoA: Her son, whom she blames for Randall
stages.whoB: His mother, who blamed and beat him

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Randall is Wendy's younger son, who drowns in a cave while playing with Marc. Wendy never stops grieving him and blames Marc.
stages.whoA: Her younger son, who drowns
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Yatzil greets Marc as Khonshu's avatar at the gods' council. After Harrow is cleared, she tells Marc that Senfu's sarcophagus will lead him to Ammit's tomb.
stages.whoA: Khonshu's avatar, whom she helps
stages.whoB: Hathor's avatar, who points him to Senfu

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Yatzil sits in judgment as Harrow wins over the gods' council. When he returns to free Ammit, she stands against him with the other avatars, and he kills her.
stages.whoA: The man who kills her
stages.whoB: Hathor's avatar, whom he kills

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aadam welcomes Kamala into his house as the Clandestines tell their story. When she backs out, he attacks her with his mace at Aamir's wedding and later chases her through Karachi.
stages.whoA: The girl with the bangle he hunts
stages.whoB: A Clandestine who attacks her with a mace

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aadam hunts Kareem and Kamala across Karachi and throws Kareem down in an alley. Kareem slips behind him and stabs him dead.
stages.whoA: The Red Dagger who kills him
stages.whoB: The Clandestine he kills in an alley

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aadam follows Najma in the hunt for the bangle, from India in 1942 to Aamir's wedding. After they break out of Damage Control, he goes with her to Karachi.
stages.whoA: The Clandestines' leader
stages.whoB: One of her Clandestines

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aadam teases Kamran about his crush on Kamala when she visits. Kamran turns on the Clandestines at the wedding, but helps them break out, and Najma leaves him behind.
stages.whoA: Najma's son, whom he teases
stages.whoB: A Clandestine who teases him about Kamala

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aadam and Fariha search for the bangle together in 1942 and fight Kamala at Aamir's wedding. In Karachi they chase her in a stolen truck.
stages.whoA: A fellow Clandestine
stages.whoB: A fellow Clandestine

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Barrie works under Deever in the hunt for Kamran, setting up patrols and the siege at Coles Academic. When Cleary relieves her, Barrie hands her the phone and pulls the agents out.
stages.whoA: His commander at Damage Control
stages.whoB: An agent under her command

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Barrie fires on Kamala as she shields Kamran outside Coles Academic, and she smashes the cannon beside him. He chases her, but the crowd blocks him and she gets away.
stages.whoA: The hero who blocks his bullets
stages.whoB: A Damage Control agent who fires on her

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Barrie fires on Kamran when he refuses to surrender outside Coles Academic. Kamran's blast of power knocks Barrie to the ground.
stages.whoA: The boy he is sent to take alive
stages.whoB: An agent who shoots at him

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Fariha fights Kamala with her spear at Aamir's wedding and again in Karachi. When the veil opens, she runs past Kamala toward home and dies.
stages.whoA: The girl with the bangle she hunts
stages.whoB: A Clandestine who fights her with a spear

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Fariha follows Najma from the bangle hunt in 1942 to the attack on Kamala's family wedding. She breaks out with Najma and is the first to run for the opened veil.
stages.whoA: The Clandestines' leader
stages.whoB: One of her Clandestines

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: In 1942 Fariha hunts for the bangle with Aisha and the other Clandestines in India. British soldiers break them up, and Aisha escapes with the bangle.
stages.whoA: A fellow Clandestine, lost in 1942
stages.whoB: A fellow Clandestine

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Mr. Wilson calls Kamala down over the intercom and talks to her about her future. He tells her to stop daydreaming and plan for college.
stages.whoA: A student he counsels
stages.whoB: Her school guidance counselor

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Mr. Wilson calls Bruno to his office with big news. He tells him he has a free place in Caltech's Early Immersion program.
stages.whoA: A student he sends to Caltech
stages.whoB: His school guidance counselor

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Kamala climbs the mosque to save Hameed when he dangles from the minaret, and asks him his favorite food to keep him calm. Her platforms break his fall, and later he praises Ms. Marvel online.
stages.whoA: The masked girl who saves him
stages.whoB: The boy she saves from the minaret

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Najaf trades news with Kamala from his food truck while she runs errands. Later he joins the crowd shielding Ms. Marvel, and boasts she loves his gyros.
stages.whoA: A regular at his food truck
stages.whoB: The food truck owner she chats with

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Nakia asks for Najaf's vote for the mosque board at the Eid party. He agrees if she makes him the only caterer for mosque events, and puts up her poster.
stages.whoA: The candidate who gets his vote
stages.whoB: A voter she wins over with a deal

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Owais greets his cousin Kamala in Karachi and teases her about her height. He tours the city with her and Zainab, then leaves her to see the train station.
stages.whoA: His cousin from America
stages.whoB: Her cousin in Karachi

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Owais welcomes his aunt Muneeba to Karachi. When Kamala does not come home, he shows Muneeba how to find her phone.
stages.whoA: Kamala's mother
stages.whoB: Kamala's cousin in Karachi

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Owais and his sister Zainab meet Kamala in Karachi and take her out to lunch and around the market. They go off together when she heads for the train station.
stages.whoA: His sister
stages.whoB: Her brother

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Rasheed is Yusuf's best friend, and is stung to see Yusuf holding Nakia's flyer. Later he sends Yusuf a video of the fight at Kamala's school.
stages.whoA: His best friend
stages.whoB: His best friend from the mosque

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Rasheed runs against Nakia for the mosque board. Yusuf hesitates to back Nakia because Rasheed is his best friend, and Rasheed is stung to see him holding her flyer.
stages.whoA: His rival for the mosque board
stages.whoB: Her rival for the mosque board

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: When Damage Control comes for Kamran at the mosque, Rasheed and Sheikh Abdullah stall the agents. Rasheed offers them his famous cookies while Abdullah stands firm.
stages.whoA: The imam he helps stall the agents
stages.whoB: A friend who stalls the agents with him

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Ruby and Muneeba trade gossip about Fatima's broken engagement as Muneeba shops for the wedding. Muneeba names Ruby as one of the people who made her feel at home, and Ruby celebrates Aamir's wedding with the family.
stages.whoA: Her friend, Kamala's mother
stages.whoB: Her gossiping friend

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Ruby tells Kamala her dress is wrong and gossips that Aisha killed a man. At Aamir's wedding she dances with Kamala, and later shields Ms. Marvel from Damage Control.
stages.whoA: Muneeba's daughter, the hero she shields
stages.whoB: A family friend

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Ruby joins the crowd around Ms. Marvel outside Coles Academic. She plants herself in front of Barrie and tells him the hero saved their lives.
stages.whoA: The agent she stands up to
stages.whoB: A bystander who blocks him

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Saleem lashes at Kamala with his whip at Aamir's wedding and corners her before Damage Control arrives. He chases her through Karachi until he is killed.
stages.whoA: The girl with the bangle he hunts
stages.whoB: A Clandestine who fights her with a whip

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Saleem points out that Kamran is only 17 when Kamala visits. After the breakout he helps the hurt Kamran, but leaves him behind on Najma's order with an apology.
stages.whoA: Najma's son, whom he leaves behind
stages.whoB: A Clandestine who says sorry as he leaves

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Saleem follows Najma from the bangle hunt in 1942 to the wedding attack. When she orders them to abandon Kamran, he obeys, and dies in her attack on the Red Daggers.
stages.whoA: The Clandestines' leader
stages.whoB: One of her Clandestines

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Saleem joins the raid on the Red Daggers' hideout in Karachi. Waleed kills him with two daggers to the chest.
stages.whoA: The Red Dagger who kills him
stages.whoB: A Clandestine he kills

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Zainab greets her cousin Kamala in Karachi and shows her the city with an app. She heads off for coffee with friends when Kamala wants to see the train station.
stages.whoA: Her cousin from America
stages.whoB: Her cousin in Karachi

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Zainab welcomes her aunt Muneeba to Karachi. She is there when Muneeba learns Kamala has gone missing.
stages.whoA: Kamala's mother
stages.whoB: Kamala's cousin in Karachi

dropped.why: Re-tested: her name is never said or shown in her only on-screen title. The s01e01 dialogue never says 'Dylan' (she answers Steven's call with 'Punchy. Calling me now?'), and the wiki's screenshots of the call show only Steven with the phone at his ear; the only phone screen shown in s01e01 is the hidden flip phone's Missed Calls list (Layla, Duchamp). No source shows 'Dylan' on Steven's phone; the only 'Dylan' said (s01e05) is an unseen Duat hospital worker. Credits only.
